paragraphs: Sol sells solar lighting systems for outdoor spaces. The EverGen Series covers streets and roadways, trails, parks, parking lots, and commercial and industrial facilities. The UP Series is an all-in-two range using a NiMH battery and an Energy Management System.

The iSSL Series is an all-in-one range combining a horizontal solar panel, an LED module, and a NiMH battery in one enclosure. The Alto is a solar-powered bollard for parks and pathways. The EverGen 3 is offered for streets, trails, parks, and commercial sites.
Buyers described on these pages range from local governments to international corporations. Funding routes listed for projects include government grants, tax credits, and subscription-based pricing.
